generation.explanation: Draw a line through one vertex parallel to the opposite side. Alternate interior angles are equal, so the two angles beside the top vertex match the triangle's two base angles. Together with the top angle, they make a straight line, which is 180°. Drag the vertices to change the triangle. The sum stays 180°.
